title: ARGUS: Source-verified thermal conductivity of BN- and AlN-filled polymer composites
description: Experimental effective thermal conductivity of polymer composites filled with h-BN, BN nanosheets or AlN, alone or in hybrids, most often in epoxy (thermal interface and packaging materials). Every row cites its source paper (DOI) and quotes the table, sentence or figure the value comes from, in an open-access full text or, for a few rows, a publicly available abstract. No value is back-calculated or model-predicted; values read from figures are pixel-digitized and, like abstract-only values, marked Medium confidence.
notes: Data licensed CC-BY-4.0; the argus toolkit in the repository is licensed MIT. Third-party papers are not included; every row cites the DOI of its source.
